pullRequest.title: S04: Personal/Library assets, float conversions and accepted closeout
pullRequest.body:
S04 adds Personal/Library subgraph save, import, export and reuse with validated dependency closure and reference remapping. Valid literal, source-bound, input-bound and nested dependencies roundtrip completely; missing or invalid dependencies are rejected atomically. It also delivers the accepted 16 float/vector edge conversions and Image Output admission under document 2.1 / Edge codec v2, while preserving exact ports and source output types.

The Human Owner accepted this tested scope and has now explicitly authorized push and merge. S04 completion is recorded; no Slice is active.

- Implementation I: `0c13932150bf1b78f215e25721292962e6c4263a`
- Independently reviewed R: `985357be67cce2f2ecc232e827e83e5cdbb521ab`; `S04-FR-985357b-01` PASS, no remaining findings or required evidence gaps.
- Completion B: `835726428f0259462c36833e0aaf9d1e72160bab`; publication head: `9a04ae7068d436c0a2ca953c89f9ad1c6e227923`.
- Build: `S04-web-0c13932`, archive SHA-256 `24b1420e04871cd76cc2a3745b1d7100aadba43db632dfa809975327e312d3b1`.

Independent validation passed all 11 acceptance families: 179 unit/conformance tests, 54 browser tests, 10 bootstrap fixtures, 9 additional counterexample groups and an exact archived-build UI check. Pre-publication verification passed 471 integrity checks, current-state validation and 10 maintenance tests. All 1,479 protected files from R remain exact; later commits contain evidence and completion metadata only. PASS remains bound to I/R.

[Accepted scope](https://github.com/yeataro/Grape/blob/9a04ae7068d436c0a2ca953c89f9ad1c6e227923/production/evidence/acceptance/s04/closeout-20261004-01/accepted-scope-01.json) · [Operator guide](https://github.com/yeataro/Grape/blob/9a04ae7068d436c0a2ca953c89f9ad1c6e227923/production/evidence/acceptance/s04/closeout-20261004-01/OPERATOR-GUIDE-01.md) · [Independent report](https://github.com/yeataro/Grape/blob/9a04ae7068d436c0a2ca953c89f9ad1c6e227923/production/evidence/s04/review-01/independent-review/INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_RESULT.json)

Qualification remains bounded to Windows x64 / Chromium 151 / WebGL2 and browser-origin storage. Personal insertion requires a valid destination graph; nested dependencies do not add arrays-of-arrays. Storage ACK does not promise disk/crash/cloud durability. Full DEC003/AC002 function emission remains NOT_DELIVERED; the S02 legacy converter remains blocked. Native Host/TouchDesigner, other devices/platforms, broader catalog and S06 appearance are excluded. No global Gate closure or next-Slice authorization.

Merge authorization: direct Human Owner message in Grape Coordinator, `01a1040f-f008-7e62-9008-f894d0dc5fee`: “我授權你推送，推送之後直接 merge。” Earlier no-merge wording in immutable closeout evidence is historical and superseded only for this accepted S04 candidate. Merge requires final expected-head, accepted-scope and GitHub checks.
